title: compute from other info
name: Compute from other info — NN/g
rule: Compute the value from other information when you can (for example state from ZIP, skip a coupon the user does not have).

citation.source: NN/g — A Checklist for Designing Mobile Input Fields

pass_when: Values derivable from answers already given are filled or skipped (e.g. state from ZIP).
fail_when: User re-enters data the form could compute, or is forced through a field that does not apply.
overview: Derive or skip values the form can compute from answers already given.
apply_when: Later fields can be filled or skipped from earlier answers.
not_when: Values that cannot be derived and must be entered by the user.
agent_hint: Prefill or skip fields computable from prior answers; do not re-ask.
description: Compute the value from other information when you can — for example state from ZIP, or skip a coupon the user does not have. Pass when derivable values are filled or inapplicable fields are skipped; fail when the user re-enters data the form could compute, or is forced through a field that does not apply. Cut retyping and dead-end prompts.
